intent.raw: invoke plan open-poll bridge after research and refresh findings
intent.objective: Author an execution-ready L0 plan that converts the manual session bridge from Codex-targeted polling to open singleton availability with claim-bound identity.
intent.operator_sentence: Plan the open-poll bridge, then execute exactly one SWU per Task Session.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The route is now an implementation plan for local Task Sessions. No subagent fan-out is required.
receipt_requirements: Every SWU returns status, capability, receipt artifact, files, validation, blockers, residue, reroute, and handoff note.

steps.name: Build refresh planning context
stop_conditions: The refresh finding does not support open singleton availability.
Existing manual bridge contract cannot preserve replay compatibility.

steps.name: Author split L0 plan
stop_conditions: An executable unit lacks source, write scope, done criteria, or validation.
The active plan imports queue, lease, background poller, provider, mutation, or IDE/browser-control scope into L0.

steps.name: Validate decomposition and recomposition
convergence_criteria: SWU-OPB-001 is executable without hidden discovery.
All nine SWUs recompose into the open singleton witness.
stop_conditions: Acceptance-critical residue has no owner or treatment.

steps.name: Execute open-poll implementation waves

outputs.ref: Task Session results for SWU-OPB-001 through SWU-OPB-006

steps.evidence_artifact: one immutable Task Session result per selected SWU
stop_conditions: No explicit ready SWU is selected.
Ready remains selector-bound or result identity is not claim-bound.

steps.name: Prove and close open-poll readiness

outputs.ref: automated, browser, witness, and readiness evidence

steps.evidence_artifact: SWU-OPB-007..009 results plus readiness closure report
stop_conditions: A race loser sees task payload.
The final receipt does not preserve stored claim identity.

gates.condition: Layering, work-pack, tasks, SWUs, waves, and validation surfaces are complete and navigable.
Smallest-unit, recomposition, hidden-gap, deferred-complexity, and navigation checks pass.
The operator selects exactly one ready SWU before each Task Session mutation.
L0 completion does not admit queues, leases, background workers, auth, mutation, providers, or IDE/browser control.

boundaries.contract: Task Session receives one selected SWU and returns a structured result before status synchronization.
Operator creates availability; claimant binds identity; kernel admits result from stored claim.

authority.execution: task-session for one selected SWU; claimant session only through bridge claim/result APIs
authority.validation: SWU owner, automated suites, Playwright, and readiness audit
authority.evidence: Task Session receipts plus ide-extension claim/result receipts
authority.memory: Invoke plan artifacts; no inventory or Craft mutation in this plan
authority.promotion: human approval through the owning lifecycle

stores: receipt projection visible in the workbench

state_namespaces.owner: invoke plan until handoff; then target lifecycle
state_namespaces.write_policy: Planning artifacts only during Invoke; no source implementation.

state_namespaces.namespace: projects/ide-extension runtime source and event state
state_namespaces.write_policy: Write only the exact SWU scope; preserve replay compatibility.
Expose open ready state and claim-bound result identity without debug-only state leakage.

promotion_splits.target: L1-L3 queues, leases, workers, providers, mutation, IDE/browser control, or packaging
promotion_splits.rule: L0 completion does not promote later layers; each needs a separate approved design and plan.
